about_the_game:
Unblock your ears and take the sounds of Trove wherever you go!

Take a musical tour through Trove's multiverse with these 18 awesome, 16-bit inspired tracks. Transport yourself back to your favorite places or go on an auditory adventure and discover the sounds of brand new worlds!

Track List

1. Trove - The Adventure Begins 02:08 (TITLE TRACK)
2. HUB - All Hallows Eve 01:40
3. Ocean Biome - Sea Faring Ways 02:02

18. DancePad - Dracolyte's Dance 02:15
